protocol.entry: First numeric reporting observation on a UTC date strictly later than the supporting-publication eligibility bound. Exact-date FX required; never advance entry to repair missing FX.
protocol.exit: Fixed 1/5/20 subsequent numeric reporting observations; a 10% loss review exits at that observed reference, not an invented stop price. No intraday fill.
protocol.calendar: Actual EIA/Fed numeric reporting dates. Blank/ND are unavailable observations, not classified as holidays. No verified exchange-product calendar or executable quote is supplied.
protocol.cost_scope: Declared illustrative sensitivities, not a quoted broker tariff. Half full spread plus slippage each leg; fixed GBP fee each leg reserved inside the allocation; exact-date GBP conversion. No leverage, shorts, interest or tax; dividends/roll/yield unavailable, so security/derivative execution is unsupported.
protocol.universe: All 51 retained events and every explicitly targeted instrument. Missing asset histories and failed windows remain in the denominator. No invented IPO allocation or opening fill.
protocol.selection: Nine predefined rule/horizon combinations; all four cost scenarios, winners and losers reported. No optimization or winner ranking in SIM-1.
protocol.allocation_scope: The allocation includes entry fees and a reserved exit fee; no leverage and no greater than 10% of cash.
protocol.currency_exposure: GBP/USD hypotheses hold unleveraged USD cash funded from GBP, valued at reciprocal USD per GBP. Oil-linked GBP/USD conversion references never become independent FX signals.

limitations: Retrospective hypothesis only. No executable product, point-in-time availability or predictive edge is established.
Oil spot and FX noon references are not exchange opening/closing fills. No roll, dividends, interest or tax is invented.
Reporting observations are not exchange sessions; blank/ND days are not automatically holidays.
Selected event corpus has selection/survivorship and regime bias; overlap controls do not prove independence.
All nine rules and four illustrative cost scenarios are retained. SIM-1 performs no fitting or winner selection.
No IPO allocation, unsupported share/gold quote, short sale, leverage or practice-account mutation.
